content.overview: Maintenance historically concerns officious intermeddling in another's litigation; champerty is maintenance coupled with an agreement for a share of the proceeds. Indian law does not treat every champertous agreement as automatically void.
content.glance: Maintenance historically concerns officious intermeddling in another's litigation; champerty is maintenance coupled with an agreement for a share of the proceeds. Indian law does not treat every champertous agreement as automatically void.
content.study: Maintenance historically concerns officious intermeddling in another's litigation; champerty is maintenance coupled with an agreement for a share of the proceeds. Indian law does not treat every champertous agreement as automatically void.\n\nRam Coomar Coondoo v Chunder Canto Mookerjee established that English rules of maintenance and champerty were not adopted as automatic prohibitions in India. Rattan Chand Hira Chand v Askar Nawaz Jung later confirmed that such agreements are not per se void, while public policy and unconscionability remain relevant.

sections.heading: Provenance, Legislative Objective & Doctrinal Foundations
sections.body: Ram Coomar Coondoo v Chunder Canto Mookerjee established that English rules of maintenance and champerty were not adopted as automatic prohibitions in India. Rattan Chand Hira Chand v Askar Nawaz Jung later confirmed that such agreements are not per se void, while public policy and unconscionability remain relevant.

sections.heading: Textual Anatomy, Provisos & Statutory Deconstruction
sections.body: The doctrines operate through common-law principles and contract/public-policy rules. Section 23 of the Contract Act may become relevant where object or consideration is unlawful or opposed to public policy. Professional restrictions on advocates are separate.

sections.heading: Mandatory Proving Ingredients & Essential Elements
sections.body: 1. Identify the funding or intermeddling. 2. Examine the funder's interest. 3. Examine the bargain and promised share. 4. Test improper object, fraud, unconscionability or extortion. 5. Apply professional rules separately where lawyers are involved.

sections.heading: Evidentiary Burdens under BSA 2023 (ss. 104–106 & s. 63)
sections.body: The funding agreement, consideration, relationship, bargaining circumstances and purpose are central. Courts examine substance rather than labels. The party challenging enforceability must establish the relevant public-policy or contractual defect.

sections.heading: Procedural Roadmap, Competent Forum & Limitation Act Checkpoints
sections.body: Disputes may arise in civil suits or contractual proceedings. Plead the specific public-policy objection. Limitation follows the underlying contractual or civil cause of action.

examples.title: Illustration 1 — Doctrine Satisfied
examples.body: Indian law does not make every champertous bargain void; enforceability depends on public policy, justice, equity, good conscience and applicable contract law. The claimant must still prove the remaining ingredients on the civil standard.

examples.title: Illustration 2 — Boundary Defect
examples.body: Indian courts have repeatedly held that champertous agreements are not per se void. A court should not infer liability from the label alone.

distinctions.title: Maintenance vs Champerty
distinctions.right: Maintenance is broader assistance in another's litigation; champerty adds a bargain for a share of the subject matter or proceeds.

rows.left: Indian law does not make every champertous bargain void; enforceability depends on public policy, justice, equity, good conscience and applicable contract law.
rows.right: Maintenance is broader assistance in another's litigation; champerty adds a bargain for a share of the subject matter or proceeds.

rows.left: Apply the ingredients of the pleaded tort.
rows.right: Do not substitute the neighbouring cause of action.

misconceptions.trap: Champerty is always illegal in India
misconceptions.correction: Indian courts have repeatedly held that champertous agreements are not per se void.
